scene.label: Act 3, Scene 4
scene.title: SCENE IV. Rossillon. A room in the Countess's palace.
scene.location: Rossillon. A room in the Countess's palace.

lines.text: Alas! and would you take the letter of her?
lines.plainText: Alas and would you take the letter of her

lines.text: Might you not know she would do as she has done,
lines.plainText: Might you not know she would do as she has done

lines.text: By sending me a letter? Read it again.
lines.plainText: By sending me a letter Read it again

lines.text: [Reads.] I am Saint Jaques' pilgrim, thither gone.
lines.plainText: Reads I am Saint Jaques' pilgrim thither gone

lines.text: Ambitious love hath so in me offended
lines.plainText: Ambitious love hath so in me offended

lines.text: That barefoot plod I the cold ground upon,
lines.plainText: That barefoot plod I the cold ground upon

lines.text: With sainted vow my faults to have amended.
lines.plainText: With sainted vow my faults to have amended

lines.text: Write, write, that from the bloody course of war
lines.plainText: Write write that from the bloody course of war

lines.text: My dearest master, your dear son, may hie.
lines.plainText: My dearest master your dear son may hie

lines.text: Bless him at home in peace, whilst I from far
lines.plainText: Bless him at home in peace whilst I from far

lines.text: His name with zealous fervour sanctify.
lines.plainText: His name with zealous fervour sanctify

lines.text: His taken labours bid him me forgive;
lines.plainText: His taken labours bid him me forgive

lines.text: I, his despiteful Juno, sent him forth
lines.plainText: I his despiteful Juno sent him forth

lines.text: From courtly friends, with camping foes to live,
lines.plainText: From courtly friends with camping foes to live

lines.text: Where death and danger dog the heels of worth.
lines.plainText: Where death and danger dog the heels of worth

lines.text: He is too good and fair for death and me;
lines.plainText: He is too good and fair for death and me

lines.text: Whom I myself embrace to set him free.
lines.plainText: Whom I myself embrace to set him free

lines.text: Ah, what sharp stings are in her mildest words!
lines.plainText: Ah what sharp stings are in her mildest words

lines.text: Rynaldo, you did never lack advice so much
lines.plainText: Rynaldo you did never lack advice so much

lines.text: As letting her pass so; had I spoke with her,
lines.plainText: As letting her pass so had I spoke with her

lines.text: I could have well diverted her intents,
lines.plainText: I could have well diverted her intents

lines.text: Which thus she hath prevented.
lines.plainText: Which thus she hath prevented

lines.text: Pardon me, madam;
lines.plainText: Pardon me madam

lines.text: If I had given you this at over-night,
lines.plainText: If I had given you this at overnight

lines.text: She might have been o'erta'en; and yet she writes
lines.plainText: She might have been o'erta'en and yet she writes

lines.text: Pursuit would be but vain.
lines.plainText: Pursuit would be but vain

lines.text: What angel shall
lines.plainText: What angel shall

lines.text: Bless this unworthy husband? He cannot thrive,
lines.plainText: Bless this unworthy husband He cannot thrive

lines.text: Unless her prayers, whom heaven delights to hear
lines.plainText: Unless her prayers whom heaven delights to hear

lines.text: And loves to grant, reprieve him from the wrath
lines.plainText: And loves to grant reprieve him from the wrath

lines.text: Of greatest justice. Write, write, Rynaldo,
lines.plainText: Of greatest justice Write write Rynaldo

lines.text: To this unworthy husband of his wife;
lines.plainText: To this unworthy husband of his wife

lines.text: Let every word weigh heavy of her worth,
lines.plainText: Let every word weigh heavy of her worth

lines.text: That he does weigh too light; my greatest grief,
lines.plainText: That he does weigh too light my greatest grief

lines.text: Though little he do feel it, set down sharply.
lines.plainText: Though little he do feel it set down sharply

lines.text: Dispatch the most convenient messenger.
lines.plainText: Dispatch the most convenient messenger

lines.text: When haply he shall hear that she is gone
lines.plainText: When haply he shall hear that she is gone

lines.text: He will return; and hope I may that she,
lines.plainText: He will return and hope I may that she

lines.text: Hearing so much, will speed her foot again,
lines.plainText: Hearing so much will speed her foot again

lines.text: Led hither by pure love. Which of them both
lines.plainText: Led hither by pure love Which of them both

lines.text: Is dearest to me I have no skill in sense
lines.plainText: Is dearest to me I have no skill in sense

lines.text: To make distinction. Provide this messenger.
lines.plainText: To make distinction Provide this messenger

lines.text: My heart is heavy, and mine age is weak;
lines.plainText: My heart is heavy and mine age is weak

lines.text: Grief would have tears, and sorrow bids me speak.
lines.plainText: Grief would have tears and sorrow bids me speak
